label: sec:qbeta-per-block-delta-tau-intro
html: Applying the per-irrep character closed forms to the neutron–proton normal-form difference \Delta_{T_\beta} = \mathcal{B}_{\mathfrak{n}} - \mathcal{B}_{\mathfrak{p}} \in H_3(q) isolates the algebraic structure of the \beta-decay trace increment \Delta\mathrm{tr}_M. This section proves the (q^2-1) factorization, records the Taylor expansion of \Delta\mathrm{tr}_M around q = 1, and establishes the canonical weight instance y_{(3)} = [4]_q/[2]_q^3, y_{(2,1)} = 1/[2]_q^2, y_{(1^3)} = 0 at z = q^3/(q^2+1).
